cases.explain: «Доброе имя» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: A good name is better than fine perfume; and the day of death better than the day of one’s birth.

cases.explain: «превосходного благовония» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: A good name is better than fine perfume; and the day of death better than the day of one’s birth.

cases.explain: «прежние дни» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Don’t say, “Why were the former days better than these?” For you do not ask wisely about this.

cases.explain: «первого совета» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: It is good that you should take hold of this. Yes, also don’t withdraw your hand from that; for he who fears God will come out of them all.
